description: Windkraftanlagen im Land Brandenburg is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Data Brandenburg. Der Datenbestand beinhaltet die Punktdaten zu betriebenen, zu genehmigten und noch nicht in Betrieb genommenen und zu geplanten Windkraftanlagen im Land Brandenburg aus dem Anlageninformationssystem LIS-A. Coverage: Open Data Brandenburg. The portal files it under the publisher Open Data Brandenburg. Its tags are 4.-verordnung-zur-durchführung-des-bundes-immissionsschutzgesetzes-verordnung-über-genehmigungsbedür, 9.-verordnung-zur-durchführung-des-bundes-immissionsschutzgesetzes-verordnung-über-das-genehmigungsv, bundes-immissionsschutzgesetz-bimschg, energie, opendata. It offers 4 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
